flows.name: FDC3 Inbound TraderX.CreateTradeTicket / TraderX.CreateOrderTicket Intent to Trade Execution
flows.description: Raises TraderX ticket-launch intents from external FDC3 apps (TraderX Intent Launcher), validates fdc3.instrument shape in TraderX UI, and executes the prefilled ticket via NGINX Ingress.

transitions.description: Trader triggers ticket launch from Sail workbench / TraderX Intent Launcher.

TraderX Ingress routes trade creation request to Trade Service API.

flows.name: FDC3 ViewOrders Intent & Realtime NATS Blotter Sync
flows.description: Handles inbound ViewOrders intents with replayable fdc3.instrument selection while merging REST open-order snapshots with live nats-ws order lifecycle events.

transitions.description: External FDC3 app raises ViewOrders intent with fdc3.instrument context.
